# STRENGTHENING OUR PERFORMANCE TOWARDS A MORE SUSTAINABLE FUTURE

Meningkatkan Kinerja Perusahaan Untuk Pencapaian Masa Depan Yang Lebih Berkelanjutan

Laporan keberlanjutan ini memfokuskan pada upaya perusahaan dalam mengoptimalisasi kinerja mereka menuju masa depan yang berkelanjutan. Melalui strategi bisnis berkelanjutan, pengelolaan sumber daya yang efisien, keterlibatan pihak-pihak terkait, inovasi berkelanjutan, transparansi dalam pelaporan, pertumbuhan jangka panjang, pendidikan karyawan, dan kolaborasi industry. Perusahaan berusaha untuk mencapai kesinambungan dalam segala aspek operasional, memperhitungkan dampak lingkungan, sosial, dan ekonomi secara seimbang.

This sustainability report focuses on the company's efforts to optimize its performance towards a more sustainable future. Through sustainable business strategies, efficient resource management, stakeholder engagement, sustainable innovation, transparent reporting, long-term growth, employee education, and industry collaboration. The company strives for sustainability across all operational aspects, considering balanced environmental, social, and economic impacts.

Foreword of the Board of Directors

Kami terus memperkuat perjalanan ESG, menekankan komitmennya untuk mencapai hasil ESG yang unggul. PT Bumi Resources Minerals Tbk (BRMS) dengan sepenuh hati mendukung pembangunan berkelanjutan, dengan berusaha menggapai masa depan pertambangan emas melalui praktik yang bertanggung jawab. Fokus kami tidak hanya sekedar keuntungan jangka pendek namun juga prospek bisnis jangka panjang yang selaras dengan keberlanjutan. Terlepas dari tantangan yang ada, tahun 2023 merupakan tahun yang luar biasa bagi BRMS, ditandai dengan profitabilitas dan kekuatan neraca yang kokoh. Kami berkomitmen untuk memastikan bahwa setiap langkah yang kami ambil dalam proses bisnis kami tidak hanya berkelanjutan secara lingkungan dan ekonomi, tetapi juga memastikan pemenuhan hak asasi manusia (HAM) setiap individu yang terlibat dalam kegiatan kami.

We continue to strengthen our ESG journey, emphasizing our commitment to achieving superior ESG results. BRMS wholeheartedly supports sustainable development, aiming to shape the future of gold mining through responsible practices. Our focus extends beyond short-term profits to long-term business prospects aligned with sustainability. Despite challenges, 2023 stands out as an extraordinary year for BRMS, marked by robust profitability and balance sheet strength. We are dedicated to ensuring that every step we take in our business processes is not only environmentally and economically sustainable but also ensures the protection of human rights for every individual involved in our activities

# Para Pemegang Saham dan Pemangku Kepentingan yang Terhormat,

Kami segenap Direksi PT Bumi Resources Minerals Tbk (BRMS) dengan bangga menyampaikan Laporan Keberlanjutan PT Bumi Resources Minerals Tbk tahun 2023. Pada edisi kelima ini, yang bertema 'Memperkuat Kinerja Menuju Masa Depan yang Lebih Berkelanjutan', menegaskan kembali dedikasi kami yang teguh terhadap pelestarian lingkungan, kesejahteraan karyawan, perbaikan komunitas, dan menjunjung tinggi standar tata kelola perusahaan yang ketat. Laporan keberlanjutan ini juga berfungsi sebagai platform komunikasi utama yang kami gunakan untuk menyampaikan tujuan dan inisiatif keberlanjutan kami kepada para pemangku kepentingan di masa depan.

Laporan ini disusun dengan mengacu kepada Peraturan Otoritas Jasa Keuangan (OJK) Nomor 51 Tahun 2017 Tentang Penerapan Keuangan Berkelanjutan bagi Lembaga Jasa Keuangan, Emiten, dan Perusahaan Publik serta Global Reporting Initiative (GRI): With Reference Option.

Sebagai perusahaan yang berdedikasi untuk mendorong pertumbuhan ekonomi berkelanjutan, BRMS tetap teguh dalam upaya mendukung inisiatif yang bertujuan mencapai tujuan pembangunan berkelanjutan. Komitmen kami diwujudkan melalui implementasi berkelanjutan Peraturan Presiden No. 111 Tahun 2022 yang merupakan penyempurnaan Peraturan Presiden No. 59 Tahun 2017. Dengan mematuhi peraturan ini, kami bertujuan untuk meningkatkan kontribusi kami terhadap pembangunan berkelanjutan, meningkatkan dampak kami pada bidang ekonomi, sosial, dan lingkungan.

# Dear Shareholders and Stakeholders,

We, the entire Board of Directors of PT Bumi Resources Minerals Tbk (BRMS), are pleased to present the 2023 PT Bumi Resources Minerals Tbk Sustainability Report. In this fifth edition, themed *Strengthening Our Performance Towards a More Sustainable Future*, we reaffirm our steadfast dedication to environmental stewardship, the well-being of our employees, the betterment of our communities, and upholding rigorous standards of corporate governance. This sustainability report also serves as our primary communication platform through which we aim to share our sustainability objectives and initiatives with stakeholders for the future.

This report was prepared in accordance with Financial Services Authority (OJK) Regulation Number 51 of 2017 regarding the Implementation of Sustainable Finance for Financial Services Institutions, Issuers, and Public Companies, as well as the Global Reporting Initiative (GRI): With Reference Option.

As a company committed to fostering sustainable economic growth, BRMS steadfastly continues to support initiatives targeting the achievement of sustainable development goals. Our dedication is exemplified through the ongoing implementation of Presidential Regulation no. 111 of 2022, which focuses on the achievement of Sustainable Development Goals and represents an advancement from Presidential Regulation no. 59 of 2017. By adhering to these regulations, we aim to amplify our contribution to sustainable development, thereby enhancing our influence across economic, social, and environmental domains

## Dengan pendekatan proaktif, BRMS berkomitmen untuk mengatasi tantangan lingkungan, sosial, dan tata kelola dengan strategi yang spesifik.

With a proactive stance, BRMS is dedicated to tackling environmental, social, and governance challenges through tailored strategies.

Selain itu, kebijakan ini memperkuat transparansi dan akuntabilitas, membangun kepercayaan dengan para pemangku kepentingan. Melalui evaluasi berkelanjutan dan inovasi, BRMS memastikan bahwa praktiknya terus berkembang, mencerminkan perubahan dalam lingkungan dan masyarakat serta menghadapi tantangan masa depan.

Moreover, this policy reinforces transparency and accountability, fostering trust with stakeholders. Through ongoing evaluation and innovation, BRMS ensures that its practices continually adapt to environmental and societal shifts, effectively meeting future challenges

## Respon atas Tantangan Keberlanjutan

Perjalanan kami menuju keberlanjutan bukanlah tanpa tantangan. Tantangan keberlanjutan menggambarkan upaya perusahaan dalam mengatasi tantangan internal dan eksternal yang mempengaruhi pelaksanaan praktek keberlanjutan.

Secara internal, kami mengakui perlunya membudayakan pemahaman yang lebih dalam tentang budaya keberlanjutan di antara karyawan. Kami berkomitmen untuk menciptakan lingkungan kerja di mana keberlanjutan bukan hanya sekadar kata-kata tetapi merupakan prinsip panduan yang tercerahkan dalam etos kolektif kami.

Secara eksternal, kami menghadapi tantangan global yang tangguh. Tahun 2023 menunjukkan kondisi yang penuh ketidakpastian di pasar global, khususnya dalam hal harga emas dunia

## Response to Sustainability Challenges

Our journey towards sustainability is full of challenges that encompass the efforts made by a company to overcome both internal and external obstacles that affect the implementation of sustainability practices.

Internally, we acknowledge the necessity of fostering a deeper comprehension of a sustainable culture among our employees. We are dedicated to establishing a work environment where sustainability is not merely a buzzword, but an enlightened guiding principle embedded within our collective ethos.

Externally, we encounter formidable global challenges. The year 2023 presented conditions fraught with uncertainty in the global market, particularly concerning world gold prices,

yang mengalami fluktuasi signifikan. Menurut data dari Bank Dunia, harga rata-rata emas 99.5% (emas murni) di London Fix Afternoon Price mencapai USD 1,942.67 per troy ounce pada tahun 2023, menandai kenaikan yang signifikan sekitar 7.9% dibandingkan tahun sebelumnya—mencatat rekor tertinggi yang melampaui proyeksi sebelumnya.

Fluktuasi harga emas ini melampaui estimasi awal, seperti yang terlihat dari Laporan Commodity Markets Outlook dari Bank Dunia edisi Oktober 2023, yang telah memproyeksikan harga emas rata-rata yang lebih rendah sebesar USD 1,800 per troy ounce untuk tahun tersebut. Meskipun dinamika pasar yang tidak terduga ini, pertumbuhan ekonomi tetap terjadi, seperti yang terindikasi oleh data dari Badan Pusat Statistik (BPS), yang melaporkan pertumbuhan sebesar 5.04% year-on-year di kuartal keempat tahun 2023—meningkat dari pertumbuhan kuartal sebelumnya sebesar 4.94%.

Di tengah situasi yang penuh tantangan ini, BRMS berhasil mencapai target yang ditetapkan untuk tahun 2023. Prestasi ini menggarisbawahi komitmen kami terhadap adaptabilitas, perencanaan strategis, dan praktik manajemen yang efektif, yang semuanya telah berkontribusi pada kemampuan kami untuk menavigasi dan berkembang di tengah ketidakpastian.

# Peluang dan Prospek Usaha

Prospek dan peluang usaha di tahun 2024 menunjukkan tren yang positif, didorong oleh beberapa faktor eksternal dan domestik yang berpotensi mendukung pertumbuhan perusahaan. Proyeksi Bank Dunia tentang kenaikan harga emas pada tahun 2024, terutama karena ketidakpastian situasi konflik Israel-Palestina, menjadi salah satu faktor pendorong. Selain itu, sentimen lain seperti indeks dolar AS, ancaman resesi, dan ekspektasi berakhirnya siklus kenaikan suku bunga Federal Reserve (The Fed) juga berpotensi mendukung kenaikan harga emas.

Di sisi domestik, pemerintah Indonesia terus memantau risiko perlambatan ekonomi global yang diperkirakan akan berlanjut di tahun 2024. Namun, perkiraan pertumbuhan ekonomi global yang stabil sebesar 3.1% menunjukkan potensi pertumbuhan ekonomi Indonesia yang kuat pada tahun 2024. Dalam menghadapi peluang ini, perusahaan akan terus mengoptimalkan produksi emas dari pabrik-pabriknya yang ada serta menyelesaikan konstruksi pabrik emas ketiga di Palu yang diharapkan dapat beroperasi pada semester kedua tahun 2024. Selain itu, pengembangan aset lain seperti tembaga, seng, dan timah masih dalam tahap eksplorasi dan pengembangan infrastruktur, dan manajemen sedang melakukan diskusi tentang pengembangan aset-aset tersebut di masa depan. Dengan adanya peningkatan produksi dari pabrik emas kedua yang mendekati kapasitas penuh dan penyelesaian pabrik emas ketiga, serta potensi pengembangan aset lainnya, kinerja BRMS di tahun 2024 diperkirakan akan mengalami pertumbuhan yang signifikan, khususnya dalam hal pendapatan dan laba bersih perusahaan.

Overall, BRMS' robust financial performance in 2023 underscores its resilience and strategic initiatives aimed at maximizing production capacity and seizing market opportunities, thereby fostering sustainable growth.

# Business Opportunities and Prospects

The outlook for business prospects and opportunities in 2024 appears promising, propelled by various external and domestic factors poised to bolster company growth. Among these factors, the World Bank's forecast of rising gold prices in 2024, particularly amidst the uncertainty surrounding the Israeli-Palestinian conflict, stands out as a key driver. Additionally, other factors such as fluctuations in the US dollar index, concerns about a looming recession, and anticipations regarding the conclusion of The Federal Reserve's interest rate hike cycle, also hold potential to bolster the gold price.

On the domestic front, the Indonesian government remains vigilant about the risk of a global economic slowdown, a trend expected to persist into 2024. However, the projection of stable global economic growth at 3.1% indicates the potential for robust economic expansion in Indonesia during the same period. To capitalize on this opportunity, the company will continue to optimize gold production across its existing factories and finalize the construction of a third gold factory in Palu, slated for operationalization in the second half of 2024. Furthermore, the exploration and infrastructure development of other assets such as copper, zinc, and tin are ongoing, with discussions underway regarding their future development. With the nearing full capacity of the second gold factory and the forthcoming completion of the third, alongside the potential development of other assets, BRMS anticipates significant growth in its performance for 2024, particularly in terms of revenue and net profit.

We define the report content determination process by implementing four stages, as follows:

## a. Identification

Identification of material topics for the Company was carried out through data and information collection. The data collection was then followed by an analysis of the impact and scope of impact from each topic. Even though we have not yet conducted a due diligence in 2023 to assess the impact of the Company's operations on economic, environmental and social aspects, including impacts on human rights, the impact identification process still looks at aspects of stakeholder vulnerability and continues to use a human rights approach. We do this with two mechanisms. First, we conducted a survey of stakeholders regarding the Company's material topics and asked respondents to rate the level of importance of material topics on a scale of very important, important and unimportant. Second, we identify issues that arise in the media and complaints submitted through the whistleblowing system (WBS). These data will provide an overview of the Company's actual and potential, negative and positive impacts on the economy, environment and society, including impacts on human rights.

## b. Priority

After the impact identification has been completed, we then group and select the identified topics based on the priority scale and the significance of the negative and positive impacts. The significance of negative impacts is determined by their severity (scale, scope, and irremediability character) and the likelihood of those impacts occurring.

# Strategi Dan Struktur Tata Kelola Keberlanjutan

(POJK51-C.1) (POJK51-A.1)

Strategi keberlanjutan dan struktur tata kelola merupakan komponen penting dalam pendekatan perusahaan terhadap praktik bisnis yang bertanggung jawab dan beretika. Strategi keberlanjutan menguraikan tujuan, sasaran, dan inisiatif yang akan dilakukan perusahaan untuk mengatasi permasalahan lingkungan, sosial, dan tata kelola (ESG) sambil memastikan profitabilitas dan pertumbuhan jangka panjang. Strategi ini mencakup berbagai bidang seperti pengelolaan lingkungan, tanggung jawab sosial, praktik ketenagakerjaan yang etis, keterlibatan masyarakat, dan praktik tata kelola. Struktur tata kelola kami mengacu pada kerangka kebijakan, prosedur, dan mekanisme Perusahaan yang diterapkan untuk mengawasi dan menerapkan strategi keberlanjutan secara efektif.

Kami senantiasa mengedepankan penerapan kinerja triple bottom line (people, planet, profit) dan mensinergikan strategi antar fungsi guna mewujudkan visi dan misi perusahaan untuk menjadi tembang mineral terkemuka di Asia.

Kinerja triple bottom line telah dituangkan dalam kerangka Kebijakan Keberlanjutan yang memuat strategi dan inisiatif keberlanjutan BRMS dan unit usaha. Kebijakan Keberlanjutan ini disusun dengan mempertimbangkan dan mengintegrasikan Tujuan Pembangunan Berkelanjutan serta berdasarkan materialitas dengan mengidentifikasi area-area yang menjadi prioritas Perusahaan.

This strategy encompasses environmental management, social responsibility, ethical labor practices, community engagement, and governance frameworks. Our governance structure denotes the comprehensive framework of policies, procedures, and mechanisms implemented by the Company to proficiently monitor and execute sustainability strategies.

## Preventing Conflict of Interest

BRMS continues to apply the basic principles of GCG, one of which is the principle of independence. This means that each department, the Board of Directors and the Board of Commissioners carry out their functions and responsibilities in accordance with the Articles of Association and applicable laws and are managed professionally without any conflict of interest.

In the highest governance body, each member of the Board of Commissioners and Board of Directors is prohibited from engaging in transactions that have a potential conflict of interest and potential for personal gain.

Based on the audit results that were carried out in 2023, we are proud to report that there were no transactions that contained a conflict of interest.

# Remuneration Policy And Procedure

Remuneration of the Company's Board of Directors and Board of Commissioners is determined based on resolution of Annual GMS taking into account the results of the Company's operations in the previous financial year, the Company's financial condition, business development plans, as well as relevant economic and industrial factors. GMS may delegate power and authority to Board of Commissioners to determine the amount of honorarium and/or other allowances for all members of Board of Commissioners and Board of Directors according to the positions, roles, duties, responsibilities and authorities of members of Board of Directors and Board of Commissioners by taking into account recommendations of NR Committee.

In terms procedure, the Nomination and Remuneration Committee carries out the following remuneration steps for the Board of Directors and the Board of Commissioners:

1. Supervise and evaluate remuneration system in order to establish a remuneration structure that is transparent, fair and competitive with the market according to the industry.
2. Evaluate remuneration system and structure at least 1 (one) time in 1 (one) year.
3. Prepare a review of the proposed improvement of remuneration and the amount of tantiem in accordance with the Company's growth.
4. Propose to GMS regarding system for providing service fees and post-service allowances for Board of Commissioners and Board of Directors.

# 3. Risiko Kegiatan Eksplorasi

Meskipun kegiatan eksplorasi dapat menemukan tonase dalam jumlah besar, namun nilai ekonomisnya tergantung pada harga logam, kadar bijih, sifat metalurgi (metallurgical properties), kondisi tambang, biaya operasi dan belanja modal untuk pengembangan serta lokasi calon pelanggan. Oleh karena itu, terdapat kemungkinan adanya cadangan yang tidak bernilai ekonomis yang pada akhirnya dapat mempengaruhi rencana kerja serta prospek usaha Perseroan di masa yang akan datang.

Risiko penurunan harga mineral menjadi tantangan terbesar bagi setiap perusahaan tambang. Oleh karenanya, kemampuan dari unit analisis bisnis dalam memprediksi harga mineral menjadi penting. Informasi tentang trend harga mineral, jumlah produksi dan permintaan mineral tertentu, kapasitas produksi dari produsen yang ada, dan informasi jumlah cadangan secara internasional menjadi bahan yang esensial untuk membuat prediksi harga mineral. Prediksi harga ini dapat digunakan pula untuk dasar pengambilan keputusan manajemen bagi keputusan investasi atau divestasi.

# 8. Production Risks

Production risks must be managed to control and smoothen operations and to take advantage of the opportunities identified. Production risks are identified in area and process that has an impact on increasing the volume or quality of the product which is ultimately related to revenues and costs.

In general, production risks are related to economic aspect, but may be closely related to non-economic risks. For example, social and environmental compliance issues will have an impact on production. Mining and processing activities may be halted if exhaust emissions are detrimental to the environment.

Examples of production risks include failure of production machinery which may lead to interrupted production and falling metal price which requires re-estimate of resources and reserves to determine economic production level.

To manage these risks, among others, is by documenting mineral content that is processed and the mixture of reagents used which will be used as material for future production process analysis, holding routine meetings to discuss each production issue comprehensively, as well as monitoring and conducting laboratory tests of solutions for any period.

The Company's intention to develop its business activities will always be an obstacle if illegal mining activities (PETI) are still carrying out their activities in the Company's Contract of Work (KK) area.

# Produksi dan Kinerja Ekonomi 2023

Saat ini BRMS telah mengoperasikan dua pabrik yang berada di Palu dengan kapasitas 500 tpd dan 4.000 tpd. Pabrik pertama dengan kapasitas 500 tpd sudah beroperasi sejak kuartal ke-1 tahun 2020 sedangkan pabrik kedua dengan kapasitas 4.000 tpd sudah beroperasi sejak kuartal ke-4 tahun 2022. Pabrik pengolahan bijih emas ketiga di Palu saat ini sedang work in progress targetnya dapat selesai dan mulai beroperasi pada Q4 tahun 2024, yang artinya akan ada penambahan produksi emas dari pabrik ketiga di tahun 2024. Kami optimis bahwa dengan semakin tingginya kesadaran masyarakat dalam berinvestasi emas, maka kami dapat mendulang kinerja positif dan lebih baik lagi di tahun selanjutnya.

Di tengah lanskap dinamis pasar global, kami telah menavigasi arus yang fluktuatif dari harga emas dunia, yang secara signifikan menguat sepanjang tahun 2023. Secara bersamaan, perjalanan kami ditandai oleh tonggak-tonggak penting, tidak ada yang lebih berdampak daripada penemuan sumber daya mineral dan cadangan tambahan di Blok 1 (Poboya) di Palu, Sulawesi Tengah. Alhasil, penemuan tersebut meningkatkan jumlah sumberdaya mineral yang ada di Citra Palu Minerals (CPM) sebesar 50% dari sebelumnya 28,4 juta ton bijih menjadi 42,7 juta ton bijih dengan rata-rata kadar emas 2,6 g/t. menegaskan komitmen kami terhadap pertumbuhan berkelanjutan dan pengelolaan sumber daya.

Secara ekonomi, tahun 2023 menjadi tahun pertumbuhan dan pencapaian yang signifikan bagi Perusahaan kami, salah satunya adalah pendapatan yang diraih sebesar USD 46.637.766. Pendapatan ini mengalami kenaikan sangat signifikan sebesar 301% dari tahun sebelumnya yang tercatat sebesar USD 11,644,445. Kenaikan pendapatan ini tentunya sejalan dengan kenaikan produksi emas pada tahun 2023 sebesar 724 kg (23,270 troy ounce) atau mengalami kenaikan 348% dari tahun sebelumnya sebesar 174 kg (5,415 troy ounce).

# Production and Economic Performance 2023

Presently, BRMS operates two factories in Palu, boasting capacities of 500 tpd and 4,000 tpd, respectively. The first factory, with a capacity of 500 tpd, commenced operations in the 1st quarter of 2020, whereas the second factory, with a capacity of 4,000 tpd, began operations in the 4th quarter of 2022. The third gold ore processing plant in Palu is currently in work in progress with a target of completion and commissioning in Q4 2024, thereby contributing to additional gold production in 2024. We are optimistic that with increasing public awareness in investing in gold, we can gain positive and better performance in the following year.

Amidst the dynamic shifts of global markets, we have skillfully navigated the fluctuating currents of world gold prices, which saw significant strengthening throughout 2023. Concurrently, our journey has been punctuated by pivotal milestones, with none more impactful than the discovery of additional mineral resources and reserves in Block 1 (Poboya) in Palu, Central Sulawesi. This discovery has augmented the mineral resources at Citra Palu Minerals (CPM) by 50%, escalating from the previous 28.4 million tonnes of ore to 42.7 million tonnes, boasting an average gold content of 2.6 g/t. This reaffirms our steadfast commitment to sustainable growth and prudent resource management.

Economically, 2023 stands as a year of notable growth and accomplishments for our company, highlighted by the attainment of a revenue totaling USD 46,637,766. This income saw a remarkable surge of 301% from the previous year, which stood at USD 11,644,445. The rise in income aligns with the surge in gold production in 2023, totaling 724 kg (23,270 troy ounces), marking a 348% increase from the preceding year's production of 174 kg (5,415 troy ounces).

# Anti-Corruption And Violation Reporting System

As a global company, we are committed to conducting business activities in an ethical and transparent manner. Corruption, bribery and other bad practices not only damage the company's image but also threaten the achievement of the Company's activity targets, the Sustainable Development Goals, and the fulfillment of human rights for stakeholders. The company has established its own anti-corruption policy, reinforcing its commitment to zero tolerance for fraudulent behavior and acts of corruption. This policy is mandatory for all personnel within the company to adhere to. Anti-corruption provisions also apply to third parties who have a working relationship with the Company through the provisions in the cooperation agreement. Every year we always conduct refresher training related to Company Regulations and Code of Ethics for old employees and induction training for new employees. Furthermore, each employee will receive a book of Ethics and Conduct and Company Regulations.

As part of efforts to prevent and overcome crime in the Company and its subsidiaries, the Company has established a reporting procedure for alleged violations of the Code of Conduct and an investigation process for internal and external fraud. This procedure is expected to become a reference standard for the prevention and control of crime in the Company and its subsidiaries, and can be implemented by all employees of the Company and its subsidiaries. Kami berupaya untuk memberikan kesempatan kepada pemasok lokal yang berkedudukan di wilayah sekitar lokasi pertambangan unit usaha yakni di Palu, Medan dan Gorontalo. Sepanjang tahun 2023, CPM tercatat menggunakan produk dan jasa dari pemasok lokal sebesar USD 3.068.228 sedangkan GM menggunakan produk dan jasa dari pemasok lokal sebesar USD 559.339.

# Empowering Local Suppliers

Wherever we operate, BRMS and business units are always committed to stimulating the local community's economy. As an effort to empower local suppliers, we are committed to increasing the level of domestic content (TKDN) in goods and services procurement activities. We do this with the hope of being able to help the local industry in creating quality products with competitive price and deliver on schedule.

We strive to provide opportunities for local suppliers who are domiciled in the area around the business unit's mining locations, namely in Palu, Medan and Gorontalo. Throughout 2023, CPM was recorded as using products and services from local suppliers in the amount of USD 3,068,228 while GM used products and services from local suppliers in the amount of USD 559.339.

Pengembangan speak up system Kami mengedepankan asas keabsahan, dapat diakses oleh pihak yang mengadakan, waktu penanganan yang konkrit, adil, transparan dan berorientasi pada pemecahan masalah.

# Community Grievance Mechanism

We use public complaints in order to take corrective action on the company's performance. Through the Speak-up System, we provide an opportunity for the public to complain about any discrepancies in our operational performance and/or business units. In handling complaints, we are committed to avoiding discriminatory actions. In developing the Speak-up System, we believe in the principles of legitimacy, accessible to the complainant, concrete handling time, fair, transparent and problem solving oriented.

We invite the public and stakeholders who wish to submit complaints to access the "Speak-up System" complaint mechanism via email: speakup@brm.co.id and the WhatsApp application at number 0811 805 2767 and we have also communicated the grievance mechanism through the website, annual reports and sustainability reports.

## Dampak Topik Material

Kami menyadari bahwa setiap insan yang bekerja dalam perusahaan kami memegang peranan penting dalam pertumbuhan dan kesuksesan kami. Namun demikian, dengan operasi perusahaan di berbagai konteks lingkungan dan sosial yang berbeda beserta kerumitan rantai pasok memberikan dampak potensial dan aktual baik positif maupun negatif kepada karyawan dan pekerja kontraktor. Dampak hak asasi manusia (HAM) ini termasuk dalam hal remunerasi, jam kerja, cakupan kesehatan dan keselamatan, pelatihan peluang, perlindungan sosial, keamanan kerja, dan akses terhadap mekanisme pengaduan.

## Management of Material Topics

### Material Topic Impact

BRMS continually work to reduce, and where possible eliminate, the health and safety risks and hazards associated with material movement, heavy equipment, and production processes throughout the mining process. # Komitmen dan Kebijakan (2-23)

Kebijakan Keberlanjutan dan Pedoman Perilaku adalah komitmen publik kami untuk menghormati HAM semua orang termasuk karyawan, karyawan kontraktor dan mereka yang berada di rantai pasok, masyarakat tempat kami beroperasi, dan mereka yang mungkin terkena dampak aktivitas kami. Kami berusaha menyelaraskan kebijakan dan komitmen HAM kami dengan International Bill of Human Rights, the United Nations Guiding Principles on Business and Human Rights (UNGPs), serta International Labour Organization's Declaration on Fundamental Principles and Rights at Work.

Hak-hak karyawan yang dilindungi oleh kebijakan tersebut diantaranya:

1. Larangan perbudakan modern termasuk pekerja anak dan pekerja paksa

Batas usia bekerja di BRMS dan unit usaha adalah 18 tahun sesuai dengan Undang-Undang Nomor 20 Tahun 1999 tentang Pengesahan Konvensi ILO mengenai Usia Minimum untuk Diperbolehkan Bekerja. Dalam setiap rekrutmen, kami selalu meminta salinan Kartu Identitas Kependudukan untuk memverifikasi umur pekerja. Lebih lanjut, kami juga menerapkan zero-tolerance terhadap praktik kerja paksa. Kami selalu bekerja untuk memastikan aspek-aspek ketenagakerjaan terpenuhi agar tidak menjurus pada praktik kerja paksa, misalnya, dengan memastikan penempatan karyawan sesuai bidang dan persetujuan dari karyawan, memastikan pemahaman isi kontrak kerja, memastikan gaji sesuai dengan standar upah minimum, dan tidak ada penahanan dokumen pekerja. (POJK51-F.19)

2. Kesetaraan dan kesempatan kerja

Kami memberikan kesempatan kepada semua orang untuk menjadi calon karyawan tanpa memandang perbedaan jenis kelamin, agama, ras, atau golongan. Seleksi calon karyawan dilakukan berdasarkan kualifikasi yang dibutuhkan pada setiap jabatan. Prinsip kesetaraan juga diterapkan dalam hal pelatihan

# Commitment and Policy

BRMS' Sustainability Policy and Code of Conduct is our public commitment to respecting human rights of our people, including our employees, contractor workers and those within our supply chains, the communities in which we operate, and those who may be impacted by our activities. We strive to be consistent with the International Bill of Human Rights, the United Nations Guiding Principles on Business and Human Rights, and International Labour Organization's Declaration on Fundamental Principles and Rights at Work.

Employee rights protected by these policies include:

1. Prohibition of modern slavery including child labor and forced labor

The minimum working age for BRMS and our business units is 18, in accordance with Law Number 20 of 1999 concerning Ratification of the ILO Convention on the Minimum Age for Admission to Work. Of every recruit, we always ask for a copy of their Citizenship Identity Card to verify their age. Furthermore, we also apply zero-tolerance to forced labor practices. We always work to ensure that all aspects of employment are met so as to avoid forced labor practices, for example, by ensuring the placement of employees according to the field and the approval of the employee; ensuring understanding of the contents of the work contract; ensuring that salaries are in accordance with minimum wage standards, and that there is no retention of worker documents.

2. Equality and employment opportunities

We provide opportunities for everyone to become prospective employees regardless of gender, religion, race or class. Selection of prospective employees is carried out based on the qualifications required for each position. The principle of equality is also applied in terms of training for employees, providing job

## 3. Hak cuti melahirkan

Cuti melahirkan merupakan salah satu hak yang didapat oleh karyawan perempuan Perusahaan. Untuk memastikan kesehatan dan keselamatan janin, bagi pekerja perempuan yang sedang hamil akan dipindahtugaskan ke dalam divisi atau suatu pekerjaan yang tidak mempunyai risiko kerja tinggi. Pada saat selesai cuti melahirkan, pekerja perempuan akan ditempatkan kembali ke posisi dan jabatan yang sama.

## 4. Hak menyampaikan pendapat dan berserikat

Menciptakan komunikasi yang terbuka dan jujur merupakan inti dari pendekatan yang kami lakukan untuk menciptakan hubungan harmonis dengan para pekerja. Kami membentuk beberapa kanal komunikasi untuk memfasilitasi komunikasi dua arah antara manajemen dengan pekerja yaitu melalui Toolbox Meeting, rapat dengan serikat pekerja, dan saat diadakannya sosialisasi atau pelatihan dari Perusahaan.

## 5. Hak atas pekerjaan yang adil dan layak

Kami senantiasa berusaha untuk memberikan gaji dan manfaat kerja sesuai dengan peraturan ketenagakerjaan dan praktik yang baik dalam pertambangan. Kami juga melarang keras segala bentuk kekerasan di lingkungan Perusahaan. Lebih lanjut, setiap kebijakan termasuk jam kerja, kerja lembur, dan kerja shift telah didiskusikan dengan pekerja untuk mengakomodir pendapat dari pekerja.

## 3. Right to maternity leave

Maternity leave is one of the rights provided for the Company's female employees. To ensure the health and safety of the fetus, pregnant employees will be reassigned to divisions that do not have high work risks. Upon completion of their maternity leave, the workers will be placed back into their same positions.

## 4. Right to express opinions and associate

Creating open and honest communication is at the core of our approach to creating harmonious relationships with our employees. We have established several communication channels to facilitate two-way communication between management and workers, namely through Toolbox Meetings, meetings with trade unions, and by socialization or training from the Company.

## 5. Right to just and decent work

We always strive to provide salaries and work benefits in accordance with labor regulations and good practices in mining. We also strictly prohibit any form of harassment and abuse in the company's area. Furthermore, every policy including working hours, overtime work, and shift work has been discussed with workers to accommodate their opinions.

## Management of Impact

To ensure the policy implementation, we work to strengthen and improve management of human rights through:

- Actively participating in and contributing to the work of the Human Resource, Procurement, and HSE Department in ensuring our targets accomplishment on human resource development and labour's rights.

# Human Resource Development Performance

We are committed to providing a safe and inclusive workplace while supporting the development of our human resources so that we can attract, reward, develop, and retain high-performing employees.

HR development is not only carried out through training but by evaluating the performance of each BRMS employees. Evaluations are carried out periodically by BRMS to monitor HR developments in an objective, transparent, participatory and non-discriminatory manner. Objective means that each assessment has the intent and purpose for the smooth running of the Company's operations as well as capacity building and character building expected of employees. On the other hand, being transparent and participatory means that the Company provides the information needed by employees in the context of this evaluation. While non-discriminatory emphasizes that performance evaluation is not related to employee background but is purely related to performance.

# Facilitating Employees With Training

BRMS is committed to the ongoing development of competency and professionalism of our people through human resource training, with a focus on leadership development, safety training, new-hire training, cross-training, refresher training and knowledge transfer.

BRMS prioritizes not just skill enhancement, but also the understanding and implementation of human rights principles across all operational facets. As part of this initiative, employee representatives attended human rights training as part of the Business and Human Rights (BHR) Academy series organized by the United Nations Development Program (UNDP), with support from the Government of Japan, and facilitated by the Foundation for International Human Rights Reporting Standards (FIHRRST) on March 1-2, 2023.

Training and education for employees organized both internally and externally focuses on strengthening leadership behavior competencies (soft competency) and technical competency (hard competency). Throughout 2023, we have facilitated 3,872 hours of training with a total of 228 employees.

## Dampak Topik Material

BRMS terus bekerja untuk mengurangi, dan bila memungkinkan menghilangkan, bahaya dan risiko kesehatan dan keselamatan yang terkait dengan proses penambangan seperti pergerakan material, alat berat, dan proses produksi. Rangkaian proses penambangan yang kami lakukan dapat menimbulkan risiko dan bahaya kimia, fisik (kebisingan, ergonomis, radiasi, panas, dan getaran), biologis, dan jenis bahaya lainnya dengan berbagai tingkatan kepada karyawan, pekerja kontraktor, dan masyarakat.

## Komitmen dan Kebijakan (2-23) (POJK51-F.21)

Kami berkomitmen memelihara dan meningkatkan kesehatan dan kesejahteraan seluruh insan yang bekerja di perusahaan kami. Komitmen ini telah dituangkan dalam Kebijakan Kesehatan, Keselamatan Kerja dan Lingkungan yang berlaku tidak hanya untuk unit usaha namun juga mitra usaha, komunitas masyarakat sekitar tambang, dan tamu.

Komitmen dalam Kebijakan Kesehatan, Keselamatan dan Lingkungan di antaranya:

1. Menghargai kehidupan di atas segala hal dan mengelola risiko dengan benar.
2. Tidak mengkompromikan nila-nilai keselamatan dan kesehatan demi keuntungan maupun pencapaian target produksi.
3. Mematuhi, menaati dan melaksanakan semua ketentuan hukum yang berlaku serta peraturan lain yang menjadi kewajiban Perusahaan sebagai standar minimal.
4. Menjalankan dan menerapkan Sistem Manajemen Keselamatan Pertambangan (SMKP) yang tinggi sehingga dapat menghilangkan atau mengurangi dampak negatif bagi seluruh karyawan, kontraktor, tamu dan pihak lainnya sesuai dengan program kerja.
5. Mematuhi norma bekerja secara aman sebagai syarat melaksanakan pekerjaan.

# Management of Material Topics

## Material Topic Impact

BRMS continually work to reduce, and where possible eliminate, the health and safety risks and hazards associated with material movement, heavy equipment, and production processes throughout the mining process. The series of mining processes that we undertake can entail risks and hazards, including chemical, physical (such as noise, ergonomic issues, radiation, heat, and vibration), biological, and other types of dangers, which may affect employees, contractor workers, and the general public at various levels.

## Commitment and Policy

We work to maintain and promote health and safety of our people. We set forth this commitment in a Occupational Health, Safety and Environment Policy that applies not only to our business units, but also to our business partners, communities around our mines, and guests.

Commitments in the Health, Safety and Environment Policy include:

1. Value life above all else and manage risk properly.
2. Do not compromise the values of safety and health for the sake of profit or the achievement of production targets.
3. Comply, comply with and implement all applicable legal provisions and other regulations that are the Company's obligations as a minimum standard.
4. Running and implementing a high Mining Safety Management System (SMKP) so as to eliminate or reduce negative impacts for all employees, contractors, guests and other parties in accordance with the work program.
5. Adhere to the norms of working safely as a condition of carrying out work.

# Mining and Environment Safety Committee

We engage the workers in occupational health and safety management through the establishment of a Mining and Environmental Safety Committee (KPL). This committee comprises the Chief Mine Officer (KTT), representatives from the Occupational Safety and Health (K3) and Mining Operations Safety (KO) sections, heads of work units, and Persons in Charge of Operations (PJO) from the Mining Services Business (UJIP).

With a cross-departmental system, we hope that aspects of mining and environmental safety and health can reach all departments and employees. In addition to these duties, this Committee also functions as a place to accommodate employees' aspirations regarding aspects of safety and health in mining and the environment. For example, employees can report hazardous conditions in their work area to members of the KPL Committee in their respective departments.

In accordance with Director General of Mineral and Coal Decree No. 185.K/37.04/DJB/2019 on Technical Instructions for the Implementation, Assessment, and Reporting of Mining and Coal Mining Safety Management Systems, the Mining Safety Committee is tasked with the following duties and responsibilities:

- Identifying, establishing, and validating mining safety goals, objectives, and programs.
- Ensuring the implementation and development of mining safety goals, targets, and programs.

## Occupational Health

In prioritizing the well-being of our employees, BRMS and its business units offer fully equipped health clinics staffed with certified doctors, catering to the health needs of both employees and contractor workers. Additionally, we collaborate with various hospitals to ensure comprehensive medical support when necessary. To proactively mitigate work-related illnesses and negative health impacts, we conduct initial, periodic, and final health assessments, which are mandatory for all employees. - Old Age Security (JHT)

PT Gorontalo Minerals (GM) Emergency Management in 2023

## 1. Establishment of Emergency Response Team

In addressing emergency situations, PT Gorontalo Minerals has established an Emergency Response Team (ERT) known as “ILATO,” registered with KaiT. The name “ILATO” derives from the Gorontalo regional language, meaning Lightning. Additionally, ILATO serves as an acronym, although its exact expansion is undisclosed.

singkatan ILATO sendiri yaitu; ILATO itself, namely

- I = Invinity
- L = Leading
- A = Awareness
- T = Team
- O = wOrk

Struktur dan tanggungjawab Tim Tanggap Darurat adalah sebagai berikut;

a. Kepala Teknik Tambang sebagai ketua ERT adalah pimpinan tertinggi di seluruh wilayah operasional yang ditunjuk dan bertugas di dalam membuat pelaksanaan proses penanganan keadaan gawat darurat
b. Koordinator ERT adalah personel yang ditunjuk untuk melakukan tindakan yang sesuai didalam kondisi gawat darurat, mengakomodir ERT dan memberikan saran kepada KTT di dalam mengambil keputusan.
c. Emergency Response Team (ERT) adalah personel yang ditunjuk untuk melakukan tindakan yang sesuai didalam kondisi gawat darurat
d. Tim teknik adalah personel yang ditunjuk untuk melakukan tindakan atau diperlukanannya saran yang sesuai di dalam kondisi darurat sehubungan dengan hal-hal yang menyangkut teknis untuk penanganan kondisi darurat seperti paramedis, first aider dan first warden.

The structure and duties of the Emergency Response Team (ERT) are outlined as follows:

a. The Chief Mine Officer serves as the ERT’s highest-ranking leader, overseeing all operational areas and spearheading the implementation of emergency response protocols.
b. The ERT Coordinator is designated to promptly respond to emergency situations, coordinate ERT activities, and offer guidance to the KTT (Komite Teknik Tambang - Mining Technical Committee) in decision-making.
c. Members of the Emergency Response Team (ERT) are tasked with swiftly responding to emergency situations and executing necessary actions.
d. The technical team comprises personnel appointed to handle technical aspects of emergency situations, such as paramedics, first aiders, and first wardens, and to provide expert advice as required.

# 3. Pelaksanaan simulasi keadaan darurat

- Tim Tanggap Darurat (ERT) perlu melakukan simulasi keadaan darurat berdasarkan dari hasil identifikasi yang telah dilakukan sebelumnya. Dimana simulasi ini bertujuan untuk mengoptimalkan keterampilan dalam melakukan penanggulangan keadaan darurat.
- Pelaksanaan simulasi dilakukan secara berkala dan dilakukan evaluasi hasil simulasi yang dilakukan.
- Dalam pelaksanaan simulasi wajib melibatkan pengamat simulasi (observer) dengan tugas sebagai penilai pelaksanaan simulasi yang akan digunakan sebagai bahan evaluasi. Observer ini adalah level staff atau personil HSSE.
- Hasil penilaian oleh observer kemudian dicatat dalam formulir observasi.

# 2. Conducting Emergency Preparedness Drills

- The Emergency Response Team (ERT) conducts emergency situation simulations based on prior identification findings. These simulations are designed to enhance proficiency in managing emergencies.
- Simulations occur regularly, and subsequent evaluation of the simulation outcomes is performed.
- Participation of a designated simulation observer (observer) is mandatory during simulations. These observers, typically HSSE-level staff or personnel, assess the simulation implementation for evaluation purposes.
- Evaluation results from the observer are documented in observation forms

# Manajemen Topik Material

## Dampak Topik Material

Dalam rangkaian aktivitas Perusahaan dan hubungan bisnis di rantai pasok memiliki risiko untuk menyebabkan dampak negatif terhadap lingkungan dan ekosistem. Dampak lingkungan yang mungkin timbul dari kegiatan Perusahaan meliputi pencemaran udara, air, dan tanah, emisi gas rumah kaca, serta penggunaan berlebihan energi dari sumber daya alam. Lingkungan hidup yang tidak dikelola dengan baik dapat mengakibatkan penurunan kapasitas lingkungan yang berdampak luas, termasuk pada keberlanjutan keamanan pangan, perubahan iklim, dan kesejahteraan ekonomi masyarakat.

## Komitmen dan Kebijakan (2-23)

Komitmen kami terhadap kelestarian lingkungan telah terintegrasi dalam Kebijakan Keberlanjutan dan Pedoman Perilaku. Dalam Kebijakan Keberlanjutan, kami berkomitmen untuk:

1. Mematuhi semua peraturan Negara dan daerah yang mengatur tentang lingkungan dimana unit usaha beroperasi.
2. Mengalokasikan anggaran dalam pengelolaan lingkungan.
3. Meminimalkan dampak terhadap lingkungan, dimana pun kami beroperasi.
4. Mendorong unit usaha untuk mengembalikan semua areal pasca tambang ke dalam kondisi yang aman, stabil, produktif, dan dengan ekosistem yang baik, sejalan dengan rencana penutupan tambang.
5. Mendorong unit usaha untuk melakukan pemantauan dan pemeliharaan terhadap keanekaragaman hayati.
6. Mendorong unit usaha untuk melaksanakan upaya konservasi air dan program penghematan energi.
7. Mendorong unit usaha untuk melakukan pemanfaatan sumber energi baru terbarukan.

# Management of Impact

## Material Topic Impact

Within the Company's array of operations and business partnerships across the supply chain, there exists a potential risk of creating adverse impacts on the environment and ecosystem. These environmental repercussions may encompass air, water, and land pollution, as well as greenhouse gas emissions, and the overconsumption of natural resources. Mismanagement of the environment can lead to a decline in environmental resilience, with far-reaching implications for food security, climate change mitigation, and societal economic well-being.

## Commitment and Policy

Our commitment to environmental stewardship has been integrated into Sustainability Policy and Code of Conduct. Within our Sustainability Policy, we are committed to:

1. Complying with all state and regional regulations regarding the environment in every business unit operation.
2. Allocating budget in environmental management.
3. Minimizing the impact on the environment anywhere we operate.
4. Encouraging business units to return all post-mining areas to safe, stable, productive conditions, and with good ecosystems, in line with mine closure plans.
5. Encouraging business units to monitor and maintain biodiversity.
6. Encouraging business units to implement water conservation and energy saving programs.
7. Encouraging business units to utilize new renewable energy sources.

# Strategy of Environmental Management 2023

In 2023, we submitted an Environmental Management and Monitoring Plan Implementation Report to the local Environment Agency in the area of operation every six months. This report comprehensively outlines our environmental management and monitoring performance, covering various aspects such as:

1. Ambient air quality, noise, and vibration.
2. Changes in land function, slope stability disturbances, and microclimate alterations.
3. Erosion, sedimentation, and surface water flow rates.
4. Water quality and quantity.
5. Landslides.
6. Generation of hazardous waste (B3 waste).
7. Disturbance of aquatic biota, as well as flora and fauna.
8. Management of public health issues and environmental sanitation.

# Environmental Commitment in the Supply Chain

We firmly believe that our supply chain is instrumental in advancing the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs), particularly in sourcing sustainable goods and services. Whenever feasible, we prioritize engagement with local communities as suppliers to the Company. Simultaneously, we ensure that risks within our supply chain are effectively mitigated through robust partnerships and comprehensive assessments of human rights and environmental risks and impacts.

We have integrated environmental, social, and governance (ESG) criteria into our procurement process for goods and services, spanning from tendering procedures to contracting terms and key performance indicators (KPIs) assessment during business unit operations.

## Identifikasi dan Mitigasi Dampak Lingkungan Hidup

(POJK51-F.28)

Melalui pemantauan lingkungan, kami mengidentifikasi dan menilai risiko untuk mencegah adanya dampak negatif lingkungan hidup dari proses pertambangan maupun produk yang dihasilkan. Proses identifikasi dan penilaian tersebut telah sesuai dengan Peraturan Pemerintah No. 22 Tahun 2021 tentang Penyelenggaraan Perlindungan dan Pengelolaan Lingkungan Hidup dan ISO 14001:2015 tentang Sistem Manajemen Lingkungan.

Unit usaha kami yaitu GM, CPM, DPM, dan LMR melakukan identifikasi dan penilaian risiko lingkungan pada setiap tahapan penambangan mulai dari ekplorasi dan perencanaan, konstruksi, operasi produksi, transportasi sampai pada tahap pascatambang. Kami bangga karena sampai dengan tahun 2023, kami berhasil mempertahankan kinerja lingkungan hidup.

During the tendering phase, we not only assess compliance with environmental regulations but also evaluate prospective suppliers' and contractors' track records in areas such as occupational health and safety, environmental stewardship, and labor practices.

Subsequently, in the contracting stage, we have incorporated environmental protection clauses into all (100%) contractual agreements with contractors, mining equipment suppliers, consultants, and other business partners. In the monitoring and performance evaluation phase, our Health, Safety, and Environment (HSE) and Supply Chain teams routinely review and assess environmental compliance aspects within the supply chain. Importantly, our commitment to environmental sustainability extends beyond regulatory compliance; we actively support our suppliers and partners in attaining environmental management standards through training and outreach initiatives.

## Environmental Impact Identification and Mitigation

Through environmental monitoring practices, we systematically identify and evaluate potential risks to proactively mitigate adverse environmental effects stemming from both the mining operations and the products. The process of identification and assessment is in accordance with Government Regulation No. 22 of 2021 concerning the Implementation of Environmental Protection and Management and ISO 14001:2015 concerning Environmental Management Systems.

As required by these regulations and standards, our business units, GM, CPM, DPM and LMR, carry out environmental risk identification and assessment at every stage of mining, from exploration and planning, construction, production operations, transportation to the post-mining stage. We are proud because up to 2023, we have managed to maintain environmental performance.

# Pemanfaatan Tailing Kering

PT CPM adalah pelopor dalam industri pertambangan emas di Indonesia dengan penggunaan Filter Press (ekstraksi kering). Pendekatan teknisnya melibatkan pemisahan lumpur dan air, di mana air yang terpisah digunakan dalam proses pengolahan berikutnya, sehingga memastikan bahwa limbah cair tidak mencemari lingkungan. Hanya dalam kondisi tertentu air akan dilepaskan ke lingkungan, sehingga metode ini jauh lebih aman dibandingkan dengan metode tailing konvensional.

Dengan penerapan teknologi filtrasi di unit Filter Press, kami menghasilkan tailing kering dengan kandungan padat mencapai 80%, yang kemudian disimpan di Waste Pile yang memiliki izin resmi. Air hasil proses filtrasi tersebut dikembalikan ke pabrik pengolahan dalam sebuah sistem yang tertutup (Closed-Circuit). Keuntungan utama dari sistem ini adalah pengurangan signifikan dalam penggunaan air dan bahan kimia sianida.

# Utilization of Dry Tailings

PT CPM is pioneer in Indonesia's gold mining sector by implementing Filter Press (dry extraction) technology. This technical method revolves around segregating sludge from water, with the separated water utilized in subsequent treatment procedures to prevent liquid waste from environmental contamination. Water discharge into the environment only occurs under specific conditions, rendering this approach considerably safer compared to conventional tailings methods.

Through the utilization of filtration technology within the Filter Press unit, we generate dry tailings boasting a solid content of up to 80%. These are subsequently stored in an officially permitted Waste Pile. The water produced during the filtration process is circulated back to the processing plant within a closed system (Closed-Circuit). This system offers a notable advantage through a substantial reduction in the consumption of air and cyanide chemicals.

# Water Resources Management

Water plays a pivotal role as a primary raw material in our operations, especially for ore processing, cooling, casting, dust suppression, and potable purposes. In order to maintain a harmonious balance with the needs of communities and ecosystems, we are committed to ensuring responsible, efficient, and safe water usage.

The management of water resources by the Company relies on the Minister of Environment and Forestry Regulation Number P.80 of 2021 concerning Amendments to the Regulation of the Minister of Environment and Forestry Number P.93/Menlhk/Setjen/Kum.1/8/2018 concerning Continuous Monitoring of Wastewater Quality and in the Network for Businesses and/or Activities to ensure the quality and availability of sufficient production and domestic water at all times. Furthermore, the CPM business unit has obtained a permit to exploit water resources for mining activities in the Pondo River, Poboya Village, Palu City from the Head of the Sulawesi River Region III Central Sulawesi Province based on No. 250/KPTS/M/2020 on 27 March 2020. In addition, CPM also has a waste water disposal permit No. 503/16.72/03/I-IPLC/DPMPTSP/IV/2021 dated 6 April 2021.

To realize this commitment, the Company focuses on three aspects of water management:

1. Reducing the intensity of water extraction from nature, especially groundwater and surface water.
2. Maximizing the use of recirculated and recycled water for production processes and other purposes such as watering and dust control.
3. Ensuring that the quality standard is appropriate for water that will be flowed back into public water bodies.

Kami menghargai setiap keluhan yang kami terima sebagai kesempatan untuk perbaikan, sambil tetap memastikan perlindungan dan kebebasan bagi para pelapor serta tidak menghambat partisipasi publik dalam kegiatan operasional kami. Hingga akhir tahun 2023, kami masih terus berdialog dengan pemerintah setempat, dinas lingkungan, perwakilan masyarakat, dan para ahli untuk menyelesaikan keluhan yang diajukan dengan tujuan mencapai solusi yang berkelanjutan dan bermanfaat bagi semua pihak.

# Environmental Complaints Handling Mechanism

BRMS and business units are committed to comply with all applicable laws and regulations related to the environment. We believe that compliance with regulations will support the Company's operations and achieve sustainable performance in economic, environmental and social aspects. To strengthen monitoring, we always support the involvement of all stakeholders in the process of continuous improvement, especially those related to mining safety and the environment, both through the mass media and other stakeholder engagement activities.

Furthermore, each business unit has developed a mechanism for handling complaints through procedures regarding Communication, Consultation and Participation number GM-HSE-PR-008. By using this procedure, stakeholders can submit complaints, findings, or consult with the PIC appointed to represent the company, namely the External Manager dan Community Liaison Officer (CLO). Furthermore, at CPM, all complaints from the community or other interested parties related to the environment can be submitted in writing to the sub-district, sub-district, environmental office of Palu City/Central Sulawesi Province.

In 2023, we received numerous complaints concerning the environment and its societal impact regarding our three business units namely fDPM, CPM, and LMR. We view each grievance as a valuable opportunity for improvement, maintaining our commitment to safeguarding whistleblowers' rights and fostering unhindered public participation in our operational endeavors. Throughout the remainder of 2023, we remain dedicated to engaging in constructive dialogue with local authorities, environmental bodies, community representatives, and subject matter experts. Our objective is to collaboratively address the grievances raised to ensure sustainable and mutually beneficial outcomes.
